restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list word is first tested by an exact packed Y9 prefilter (Lemma PF, U_PF = 8 units, its six constants in registers): exhaustive enumeration of the bit-serial decision of condition (1) over all 1024 low-ten-bit prefixes leaves 14, all with Y9 bits {0,1,2,6,7,8,9} equal to 0x004 or 0x3c4, so a word with no such lane holds no lane passing test (1) and is skipped losslessly; E work is charged only for the lanes of kept words. The word charge is 46 (the base entry's 45 without its -1, which a skipped word does not execute; a kept word spends it on its W add). No H_HIT premise is used: no hit rate is assumed; the one new premise H_PF bounds only how many words are kept and is protected by the W <= WB halt.

The member class has 262144 members of each type. Exact E-word counts are 23820160 and 34028800 and each type has 4160 live low-half states; the online source builds both tables and checks these identities. Messages are distinct and the four fixed digest words are checked by the inherited construction.

The exact integer ledger, all budgets, power certificate, memory and inherited success premises are in the first section of proof.md. N=85846220271156872085 and log2(N/430)=57.47019556838192, rounded up to 57.4702 (base entry 9638e58: 57.6134). The kept-word budget PF_BUDGET = ceil(WORDS_BUDGET/8) + s = 136873290891095995 and EPF_BUDGET = 7 PF_BUDGET = 958113036237671965 replace the E-lane term of WB; WB = 65028303193655215911 and W_CTX = 45818253.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, the expected number of list words kept by the exact Y9 prefilter is at most 0.11 times the expected number of list words; by Hoeffding over contexts the kept words stay within PF_BUDGET except with probability at most exp(-20).
heuristics.scope: The kept-word and kept-lane work budgets of the counter walk; it does not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: Uniform projections would give 1-(1-2^-6)^7 = 0.1044; the shipped search was measured directly: 200,000 contexts, 1,691,699 list words, kept share 0.10463, largest of 20 batches 0.10610; the budgeted 1/8 is 1.195 times the overall share and 1.178 times the largest batch (first section of proof.md).
heuristics.limitations: A heuristic premise on a work count, like H4' and H_G_cluster; if it failed the run would halt by the work register and only the success probability would fall; the time bound holds for every run.
